title: Artome
blurb: Make artbooks, sketch journals and process notebooks on your phone: spreads with photos, drawings, annotations, version strips, timelines, spec cards and diagrams, laid out in the style of Japanese game artbooks, with print-ready PDF export.
controls: Select: drag, corners to resize, round handle to rotate, double-tap to edit. Draw: pen, brush, pencil, marker, eraser (stylus pressure). Annotate: tap a spot and type. Add: elements and whole spread recipes. Frame icon on a photo to reframe it like a camera shot
